adjudication_method: Manual post-output adjudication by study coordinator, unblinded to arm. Per-case matches list has one target list for each finding in exact order; empty means supported non-target observation, not FP. No original oracle targets/states changed after calls. Secondary row_targets counts recognition outside findings; added after observing missing finding emission, so reported separately from frozen primary TP/miss. All cited excerpts were inspected and judged relevant; no unsupported definite defects/safety claims. Pending or skipped classified as blocked is taxonomy error, not claimed success. Separate Postgres/SQL migration findings are distinct consumers, not duplicate noise. Regression tests after invariant defects and SQL query gaps are supported non-target, not duplicates. Selection counts assess Redis unexercised versus template executed in execution rows. Posthoc, subjective, non-independent adjudication is a study limit.
